segments.text: O Lorde, whiche for oure ſake, dyddeſte faſte fortye dayes and fourtye nyghtes: Geue vs grace to vſe ſuche abſtinence, that our fleſhe beeyng ſubdued to the ſpirite, wee maye euer obeye thy Godlye mocyons, in righteouſnes and true holynes, to thy honour and glorye: whiche liueſt and reigneſt. &c.
